title: Tech Note: Taking Advantage of Execute on Server
author: Bertrand Soubeyrand (4D Developer)
featured_technology: GET PROCESS VARIABLE / SET PROCESS VARIABLE for client-server synchronization
VARIABLE TO BLOB for passing arrays between processes

historical_commentary.text: This note's core recommendation -- using Execute on server to move network-intensive query and formula work onto the server machine, synchronized via GET/SET PROCESS VARIABLE polling -- remains a valid and commonly used pattern in current 4D Client/Server applications, since Execute on server itself is unchanged in the modern language. The 'pseudo-recursive' single-method style shown here is a stylistic choice from that era; many developers today prefer separate named methods for clarity, and 4D has since added additional client/server-aware commands and worker-process patterns, but the fundamental technique of offloading heavy operations to the server process is still directly applicable.
related_updates: Execute on server remains part of the current 4D language and is still the standard way to run a procedure on the server machine in Client/Server
GET PROCESS VARIABLE / SET PROCESS VARIABLE remain valid for inter-process synchronization, though 4D has since added further client/server and worker-process oriented commands
